_comment: Sourcing links, in the order the deck shows them (10-19: local stores first, then RockAuto, then Row52; no Google). {pn} = OEM part number, {pn_lc} = lowercase, {q} = URL-encoded free text, {zip} = home ZIP from sourcing.json. 'verified' = the URL pattern was checked against the live site. O'Reilly and AutoZone keep the store you pick on your phone; their search URLs take no ZIP or radius.
